stats.title: How to Look Elegant & Expensive at Home (On Any Budget)

structure.what_is_said: 'Have you ever caught a glimpse of yourself at home and thought, "Wow, this is not my finest moment." Hair in a lopsided bun, random sweater, questionable pajama pants. We've all had those days. But what if I told you you can look elegant and expensive at home without dressing up, without spending a lot, and without giving up comfort, no matter your budget, your routine, or how chaotic your mornings are. Elegance at home is surprisingly simple.'

tricks: HOOK (Q1): 0:00-0:26 = 11 picture changes (2.5 s average). Line by line: 'Have you ever caught a glimpse of yourself at home' = chic hat woman (0:00); 'not my finest moment / lopsided bun / questionable pajama pants' = Breakfast at Tiffany's Audrey waking in a sleep mask (0:02-0:09) - a humorous literal match with a classic icon; 'We've all had those days. But what if I told you you can look elegant' = before/after cut-out photos side by side (0:11-0:14); 'at home without dressing up...' = row of 3 women in white loungewear (0:15); 'no matter your budget, your routine, or how chaotic your mornings are' = FULL reels of women in white robes (0:18-0:26, 2 hard cuts at 0:21). No text in the hook. Title at 0:30 (30 s in): 'Episode 13 / How to Look Elegant at Home' over Marilyn Monroe, preceded by an 'In today's video...' card at 0:28.

POINT OPENING (Q2): fade to white (sometimes the card starts writing while the caramel is still fading, 2:31 and 3:24) -> '<n>. <Title>' black script written on, 3-5 s; the voice does not read the title, it starts the point's first sentence over the card (e.g. card '1. Refresh & Retire' while saying 'Most of us have that one drawer...'). After the card: a cream/caramel beat or straight into a centred clip or row.

POINT CLOSING (Q2): most points end on a quote beside a picture or a centred quote card that repeats the spoken line: 1:20 ('You deserve to feel put together even in private'), 3:17-3:23 ('The goal isn't perfection...'), 4:50 ('They're a quiet reminder that you matter too'), 6:25 ('True elegance starts when you decide you're worthy of your own gentleness'). Point 6 ends on a 28-s ritual montage of rounded clips instead.

CLIP HOLDS (Q3): FULL clips 2-6 s (window ledge 4:53-4:58 = 6 s); centred rounded clips 1-8 s - candle ritual 3:30-3:37 = 8 s, knit dress 7:15-7:20 = 6 s, steaming 7:21-7:27 = 7 s, top-down drawer 5:32-5:37 = 6 s; rows that build 5-12 s (2:59-3:10 = 12 s); quote cards 3-10 s.

ROWS (Q4): 3 panels most often, 4 when 4 garments are listed (2:49-2:57; 2:59-3:10). Rows build ONE PANEL PER GARMENT OR PHRASE on the spoken word: 'lounge set' / 'layered over' / 'soft trousers' / 'knit jumpsuit' (2:49, 2:51, 2:52, 2:54); 'Beige joggers' / 'similar' / 'sweater' (1:40-1:42); 'lace trim' / 'shorts' / 'drawstring' (6:54-6:59). Panels slide in from slightly different heights then line up (1:10-1:12). Panels are always different women; ages and bodies vary on purpose: pregnant woman + Martha Stewart-like ~80-year-old (1:45-1:46), older blonde (1:42), plus-size (0:57, 1:11, 3:12, 6:16), two ~60-year-old women in linen (3:13), mothers and adult daughters of different ages (4:29-4:31), Black women (1:10, 2:01, 4:30, 4:46, 5:44, 6:20).

BACKGROUND SWITCHES: caramel for most of points 1-2 and 4; CREAM (warm off-white) for points 3 and 5 and the hook; a TAUPE/greige background only for the bedtime ritual montage (7:15-7:43) - the background colour changes with the mood of the section.
ROUNDED CLIPS: most centred clips in this video have rounded corners (e.g. 2:14, 3:30, 3:42-3:56, 4:03-4:09, 7:15-7:43); landscape couple clips are also rounded and centred on caramel.
